title: The road to Bryce: 149 miles around #Shorts
description:
Zion Canyon is a box canyon: the road went in and came out the same way. To drive from Zion to Bryce Canyon you had to go 149 miles the long way around.

▶ Full documentary (Zion, Part 3: The Impossible Tunnel): https://youtu.be/30zzYRt_Mgk
